text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding sample app hitting inconsistent embedding shapes when using the JS client. Seen on macOS + Node 18.

maria: Behavior: single input -> returns `embedding: [number,...]`. batch input (array of 2+) -> sometimes returns `embeddings` where one item is flattened into the parent array, e.g. `[ [v1], v2, [v3] ]` or even `[v1, v2]` where v1 is length 3072 instead of two separate 1536 vectors.

kevin: ugh. do you have the raw http payloads? is server returning that or is it our SDK helper?

maria: captured network trace from sample-app: server JSON under /v1/embeddings looks normal: "data": [{"embedding": [0.001,0.002,...]}, {"embedding": [0.003,0.004,...]}] — but client-side `embeddings` helper outputs a malformed shape.

anya: quick theory: we optimized a fast-path for single-element arrays that avoids allocating nested arrays; if a code path merges fast-path and batch-path results when retrying, shapes could get mixed. Also saw one report where auth refresh triggered a retry mid-response and partial body merge happened.

maria: repro steps I ran:
1) git checkout feature/onboard-embeds
2) REDWOOD_API_KEY=shortlived node examples/onboard.js (calls embeddings.create with input array of 2 strings)
3) Sometimes prints `embeddings` as expected, sometimes prints one long flat vector plus one nested vector, ordering is off.

maria: example code:```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwoodai/js')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1536', input: ['a','b'] })
console.log(JSON.stringify(resp.embeddings))
```

kevin: can you reproduce deterministically? maybe by forcing token refresh?

maria: yep. env hack: set the token to expire immediately in the auth mock so the client refreshes mid-flight. Then I run two parallel batch requests. Very often one of them merges chunks and you see duplicates or flattened vectors.

anya: filing DEVEX-4210. Proposed fixes: 1) in SDK, add `normalizeEmbeddings(response)` that ensures `Array<Array<number>>` shape and validates lengths; 2) make the retry/refresh path re-run the full request instead of attempting to merge partial results; 3) add a helpful error `EmbeddingShapeError` when expected vector length mismatches configured model dims.

kevin: +1. Also add unit tests that simulate partial JSON merging and token refresh during request. Add an e2e in sample-app that runs `node examples/onboard.js` 100x to catch flakes.

maria: small UX note — the sample app currently does `if (res.embeddings[0].length === expectDim) ...` which crashes when res.embeddings[0] is a number. We should update README and add a helper `ensureBatchVectors(resp)` in devex-utils and call it in sample-app.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-4210 "js-sdk: embeddings batch shape + retry merge" (https://tracker/redwood/DEVEX-4210) by anya :white_check_mark:

anya: I'll pick up the SDK fix. Plan: normalize + tests today, sample-app patch tomorrow. Will include changelog entry and a short note in onboarding checklist to run the validation script after SDK bump.

kevin: once PR is up ping QA. If server traces show no corruption, we close as client-only.

maria: thanks — confirmed fix locally with normalize helper. leaving for QA to verify in CI matrix.
